title: Meeting lines in the room, an open calendar that follows other people's changes, and the form by keyboard
spec: docs/MEETINGS.md, slice T370b follow-up. The app's chat session keeps each room's MeetingLine pushes (client-core's ClientEvent::MeetingLine) by cursor as 'author text' and counts them; SignedInSession::calls lists them among the room's history lines in cursor order, so the window shows them between messages like call lines (they never count as unread: the server's rule). When the count changes after a room sync and the window has asked for a calendar week, the worker reads that week again, so another device's change reaches an open calendar without a command from the window. The calendar form opens with focus in its title; Tab goes title, start, length, agenda, Save, Discard changes; Enter in a one-line field saves as Save does (crates/desktop-ui/tests/t370b2_calendar_keyboard.rs). End to end over a real server: Bob's app shows Alice's scheduled line and next week's meeting, and after Alice edits it on her device his worker reports the edited line and the week with the new title.
